attBesluta.text: Bon article, reçu après des difficultés avec le transporteur mais le service client Vevor a été très bon. Une étoile en moins parce que la finition des bacs en plastique n'est pas propre, j'ai repassé un coup du cutter ou ébavurer.
Helaas bij aankomst was het product al beschadigd. Foto toevoegen wil niet maar er mist een stukje hout van het blad

Bought this as a portable work bench top at my job sites. It does a great job, holds a ton of weight. I just throw a sheet of plywood on top and work from there. Might even get a smaller one for smaller sites.

Bought this portable table over a month ago and it’s already proving to be very versatile. A little on the expensive side, but undeniably useful and easy to store in smaller areas. Set up and tear down takes seconds so I have a stable workstation anywhere I go.
we needed a mobile table on the construction site. we used trestles and formwork before. this is much more practical. it seems quite robust
Easy and quick to assemble. Net feels durable, folds easily, great backyard lacrosse goal especially given the price compared to other full size goals.
This was easy to put together. My son and I had it together in 30 mins. He loves playing in the back yard.
Purchased for my daughters who both play lacrosse. It took all 3 of us to hold up and put together. Instructions are definitely not the best, but not awful to figure out

So far we're very pleased with this net and we like the fact that it folds up for somewhat compact storage. That should help it last a long time compared to the ones that are left outside. Being that it's more portable it is a little more light duty than a standard lacrosse goal but that is fine practice or I met for the yard

Really good quality, one of the folding joints was a little bent and fit together just a little off making it difficult to put the pin in that prevents it to fold. I really hope it will when we need to put it away.

Very easy to set up the goal frame itself. The net was tricky to attach with the bungee straps. But once it was put all together, it is holding up to my 10u shooting on it. Great for the backyard to get those extra reps in.
This thing. Worked really well even with the wind blowing hard at the beach
